title: UNI concept row
description: One row of the append-only concept registry at evidence/concepts.ndjson. A MAP OF THE SYSTEM, not a dictionary: every row must name a `locator` that resolves in code or in a governing document, so the registry describes words this platform actually turns on rather than a vocabulary invented beside it. The specification asked for a Latin-anchored semantic layer with phonetics and reversible translation; this is its minimum honest form. Latin is an ANNOTATION here and is never the primary label on any operator-facing or public surface — a Latin lemma you must learn in order to operate the system is the opposite of the education ladder's purpose.

concept_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never renamed; superseded by a later row instead.

english_operational_definition.description: What you would MEASURE or DO, not what the word evokes. If it cannot be stated operationally, the concept is not ready for this registry.

locator.description: REQUIRED, and the load-bearing fence: a repo-relative `path` or `path:line` where this concept is defined in code or in a governing document, OR a declared external namespace (e.g. 'uni-lab-mcp:<tool>') listed in the verifier's own header. A concept with no locator is a word someone liked, and the registry refuses it.

latin_lemma.description: The canonical Latin anchor, dictionary form. NULL is legal and is the honest value when no defensible lemma exists. Never the primary label on any surface.

latin_form.description: Grammatical form actually used (case, number), when it differs from the lemma.

ipa.description: International Phonetic Alphabet for the Latin form. NULL is legal and expected. A value here REQUIRES ipa_source: Classical and Ecclesiastical pronunciations genuinely differ, and an unlabelled IPA is false precision.

ipa_source.description: Which pronunciation tradition the IPA follows. Required whenever ipa is non-null.

back_translation.description: The Latin rendered back into English WITHOUT sight of english_operational_definition. It must DIFFER from that definition: a byte-identical back-translation is evidence the procedure was skipped rather than evidence the translation is good.

ambiguity_flags.description: Known ways this mapping can mislead. Recorded, never resolved by fiat.

confidence.description: THREE WORDS, NO NUMBER — the same discipline the release verdict uses. `attested` requires a corpus citation in `source`; without one the ceiling is `constructed`. `provisional` means the locator is external or unpinned.

source.description: Corpus citation supporting an `attested` confidence. Required for that value.

reviewer.description: Who checked this row. NULL until a human has. A reviewer name is a CLAIM, not a measurement.

superseded_by.description: concept_id of a later row that replaces this one. Rows are never edited or deleted.
